answer: Because the ivory beacon is unpredictable until close, the mesa panel cannot be arranged, and the plume audit records the draw inputs for every case. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. The 6 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
